name: Dr. Faust
source:
The sexual health and development specialist at the Medical Center of Vesper—and the alter-ego of the demoness Lilith. It's unclear how she spends most of her time, as she appears and disappears seemingly on a whim. She holds a particular interest in Leslie and the protagonist.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
